theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P) (W : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → Measurable f → Measurable G → MeasurableSet W → W ⊆ Φ '' Ω → (∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w ∈ W → f (Φ w) = h w ∧ G (Φ w) ≠ 0 ∧ G (Φ w) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap ∧ ∀ u, inner ℝ (G (Φ w)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w u) = fderiv ℝ h w u) → ∀ g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in W ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in W ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in W, ‖G x‖ₑ * g x ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))
